title: Minimum Garden Perimeter to Collect Enough Apples
goal: Find the smallest square garden perimeter yielding enough apples.
strategy: A centered square with coordinate radius r contains 2*r*(r+1)*(2*r+1) apples. Binary search the smallest sufficient integer radius and multiply it by eight.
